event.description: Union closest shared FF-output scalar groups 25 and 128
event.proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,556 parameters at 99.050000%, a +0.050000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 67 prior macro-attempts in this family and 583 prior micro-trials. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0169/micro-0020 at 1,566 parameters and 99.02%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0168/micro-0005 (FF-output pair 183/223 discarded at 98.99%). This is a parameterization-preserving compression of the depth-shared feed-forward output map: union flattened coordinates 25 and 128, values 0.1410306841 and 0.1415129155 (difference 4.822e-04), using a weighted mean and integer reconstruction. Hypothesis: residual-stream reconstruction contains near-duplicate scalars distinct from FF-input redundancy, preserving qualification at 1,555 parameters. It is more informative than the next FF-output union (difference 4.827e-04) because it is the minimum-distortion isolated test of the complementary FF map. Official acceptance and rollback are unchanged.
